run_WorkerServer_RunServer: run a gRPC benchmark worker server that starts, reports status, and stops on request
run_WorkerServer_RunClient: run a gRPC benchmark client with closed loop or open loop Poisson load patterns
create_WorkerServer_create_server: create a gRPC benchmark server with async or generic handler and optional SSL credentials
create_WorkerServer_create_client_runner: create a client runner for sync or async benchmark clients with configurable load parameters
call_WorkerServer_CoreCount: call the worker server to return the number of CPU cores available on the machine
